inputs.text: An ornate clockwork alchemical bottle containing a detailed cosmic and mechanical scene, standing on a dark weathered wooden surface. A uniquely shaped glass potion bottle with swirling dark blue and purple liquid, a dark wax seal with a complex celestial crest wrapped in miniature brass and copper clockwork gears, an interwoven copper and bronze cage with gear accents, and an aged parchment label reading 'Celestial Potion' and 'Temporal Shift' in clockwork borders. Inside the liquid, a miniature clockwork universe: a detailed copper and brass orrery with a glowing golden orb at its center, a tiny copper observatory tower, miniature trees and hills, and a deep purple-indigo night sky full of swirling galaxies and a visible spiral galaxy. Soft golden hour light from a blurred sunset meadow background, internal magical luminescence glowing gold and violet-blue, subtle glints on brass and glass, dramatic clouds, dark academia mood, photorealistic fantasy prop photography.
